_comment: Which findings `/apply-replies` may fix without the owner's sign-off. A rule id listed under `mechanical` (or matching a prefix in `mechanical_prefixes`) only asks for text that does not change behavior: comments, docstrings, test assertion messages, includes, formatting. Every other rule, and every rule listed under `signoff`, needs `/approve`. A mechanical edit must also pass the deterministic check in apply_replies.py (only comments, whitespace, includes, or string literals in test files change); if it does not, it becomes a proposal too.
